text_block_list.text:
After spending some time out with Grass

Wonder...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Look at that, Trainer. The setting sun's
reflection
on the river is so beautiful.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Splash!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Oh? Did something just fall in?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I was so sure this scenery would
jog my
memory! Grrr!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text: Taiki? What are you up to?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Oh! Grass! I'm just here rackin' my brain
over
somethin' I forgot from earlier! It's
drivin' me nuts!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text: I wonder what it could be...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
It's some Japanese poem I learned in
class! It's got
somethin' to do about a
frog fallin' in some water.
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
Don'tcha worry, though. That splash ya
heard just
now was a stone I threw, not a
frog. Hahaha!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
Oh, is it the haiku written by the famous
poet
Matsuo Basho?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Uhhh... The name kinda rings a bell...
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
But the Japanese was kinda complex, so
I can't
remember what it meant!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text: Oh dear...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер
choice_data_list: Why not tell her in English?

text_block_list.text:
Well, I declare! Givin' me the English is
sure to do
the trick!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text: Very well. If I recall correctly...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
By an old pondside, A frog leaps and
breaks the
still With watery thump.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Oh! That's the one! No doubt about it!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
It's such a beautiful poem! Like that
wabi-sabi
whatchamacallit, right?
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
Yes. I think it's expressed well in English
too.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Its form and rhythm creates a faithful

representation of the original, allowing
the haiku
to touch the hearts and minds
of people around
the world.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: That's right! It's super pretty!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
Well, that sure takes a load off of my
shoulders!
Thanks a bunch!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
One can always count on a proper
Nadeshiko gal
like you havin' your
studies all in order!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
Well, I'll catch y'all at a later time. I'm
fixin' to go
hunt some jumpin' frogs!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text: No more skipping stones, though!
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Hehe. Taiki is such a ball of energy.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Still, did she call me a "Nadeshiko gal"?
What a
curious phrase...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер
choice_data_list: Maybe I'll start calling you that too.
You bridged a gap between Japan and America.
"Nadeshiko gal" has a nice ring to it.

text_block_list.text:
Still, did she call me a "Nadeshiko gal"?
What a
curious phrase...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер
choice_data_list: Maybe I'll start calling you that too.
You bridged a gap between Japan and America.
"Nadeshiko gal" has a nice ring to it.

text_block_list.text:
Dear me... That would make things a
little
awkward, wouldn't it?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Why, if you were to use that name, I
might have
to follow suit and call you
"Trainer Samurai"!
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер
choice_data_list: Umm... Can't say I'm exactly a fan...

text_block_list.text:
Right? Now, let's be on our way, Trainer

Samurai. ♪
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Hehehe. That's nice of you to say.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I'm glad that I was able to connect two
places I
love.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер
choice_data_list: Tell me more about America sometime.

text_block_list.text:
Gladly. You can rest assured this
Nadeshiko gal
won't disappoint you.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Nothing would make me happier than to
teach
you about my home. ♪
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Hehe. I've taken a liking to it.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I think I'm more of a Nadeshiko gal than
a
traditional Yamato Nadeshiko.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I'd actually love it if my fans could call
me that
when they cheer for me at races,
too.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: It really shows the inspiration I draw from both my homes—Грасс Вандер, a Yamato lady and an American gal.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'm counting on you, then.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Japan and the US. You and I. In each
case, both
elements are essential.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
A single strand doesn't make a rope.
With you by
my side, I believe it may
come to be. ♪
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Грасс Вандер regales me with stories
about
America all the way back to the
academy.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As we set out back to the academy, I
fervently
beg Грасс Вандер to go back
to addressing me
normally.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Today, I strengthened my determination
to reach
the top with Грасс Вандер.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
